evals.prompt: Use the performance skill. Optimize my Next.js site for Core Web Vitals. LCP is 4.2s, CLS is 0.23 In this session you have no project files and no shell, and nobody to ask. Do not ask questions: assume a typical Next.js App Router project and answer in text with concrete findings, what you would check, the fixes and the code you would write.
evals.expected_output: Identifies specific LCP and CLS issues and implements targeted fixes
expectations: The answer says to check that the LCP image has loading="eager" and fetchPriority="high" (or preload in Next.js 16 when one LCP image fits every viewport) and a sizes attribute; does not recommend the deprecated priority prop on Next.js 16
The answer says to verify next/image is used instead of native img tags
The answer says to check for AVIF/WebP format configuration in next.config
The answer says to verify next/font usage (no external font requests causing CLS)
The answer says to check all images have explicit width/height or fill prop
The answer says to look for dynamic content injection above fold causing CLS
The answer does NOT reference FID (replaced by INP in 2024)
